Package com.microservices.user.application.jwt

Class TokenGenerator

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.user.application.jwt.TokenGenerator
@Service public class TokenGenerator extends Object
Service class for generating JWT tokens including access and refresh tokens.

This service provides methods to generate access and refresh tokens with additional claims based on the user details. It uses JwtService to handle the token generation and UserService to fetch user details from the database.
